title: Parameter-Robust Subspace Correction with Multiple Semidefinite Penalties
summary: Independently weighted semidefinite penalties arise in augmented-Lagrangian and constrained formulations. This paper characterizes when an exact additive subspace-correction preconditioner remains uniformly effective over all nonnegative penalty weights on a fixed finite-dimensional space. Robustness holds precisely when the correction spaces decompose every joint kernel generated by a nonempty subset of penalties.
